tcgcsv-90186.headline: Up 150% on the year: Unown (S) (EX Unseen Forces) S/28 went from $21.91 on Oct 23, 2025 to $54.79 on Oct 26, and is up 22% over 7 days and up 34% over 30 days. That beats its set over 30 days: up 34% against a +1.2% median for 75 EX Unseen Forces items priced $5.00 or more, and +0.6% for 9933 priced items across the market. That is its highest price on file, back to Feb 8, 2024, above the earlier peak of $48.49 on Oct 25.
